title: StoneEra, a voxel colony builder where you can shape the land and grow a settlement
author: Arrock12
selftext:
Hey everyone! I’m working on **StoneEra**, a voxel colony-building game where you build a settlement, grow food, craft resources, and shape the terrain around you.

I put together this short video to show the kind of world I’m building. The scenes were staged for the video, but they show the game’s visual style and some of its features.

There’s a free demo available on Steam if you’d like to try it: [StoneEra on Steam](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5057770/StoneEra/)

I’d love to hear your thoughts: **what would you like to see in a colony builder like this?**

comments.author: aigamedev-mod
comments.body: u/Arrock12 please add details on how AI was used to make this. Just stating that you used AI doesn't pass the rule. The community is a dev community, add dev details. Rule 4 is there to make sure promotional posts contribute by getting into the process and actual development. There's a real risk of the sub being swamped by self-promotion. If you don't update, this post may be removed.

replies.author: Arrock12
replies.body:
Thanks for letting me know! I’ve updated the post with more details about how I used AI in StoneEra’s development.

I used generative AI tools to help create some of the game’s 3D assets. I reviewed and edited the AI-assisted content before integrating it into the Unity project, so it would fit StoneEra’s voxel style and the rest of the game.

I also used AI-generated music and a synthetic voiceover for this promotional video. The scenes themselves were staged in the game engine.

The use of AI-assisted 3D assets is also disclosed on the Steam store page. I’ll make sure to include more development details in future posts.
